text:
GRF Runway Cond is now GRF Toolbox. New since the first version:
• Your flight: add it once on Home (paste the flight plan from AvioBook, or type From and To). Each tool then shows its part.
• Runway Cond: METAR and TAF beside the SNOWTAM. Official sources only (ATIS Guru removed).
• SIGMET: worldwide on a globe, and those on your route.
• Route: your profile with SIGMETs and forecast wind, icing and turbulence, ETP, and PA notes.
• Timezones: local times and clock changes along the way.
• Flight times: block, flight and night time.
Problems or ideas: Send feedback at the foot of every page.
